newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up in continued market rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up in continued market rally.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed sharply up on Thursday as the market rally continued amid aggressive retail buying and institutional support.

Brokers said investors maintained interest in engineering, food and some select financial scrips, pushing the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index up by 37.21 points or 2.88 percent at 1,328.8 on a turnover of 168.3 million taka. Of 123 issues traded, 88 ended up, 30 closed down and five unchanged.
Bangladesh Lamps gained 211.05 taka to 3,889.59, Apex Foods was up 121.33 to 5,284.93 and IDLC rose 67.03 to 3,948.08.
